28658.d: The Varrock Dig Site is an archaeological excavation area just east of Varrock, at the Archaeology Campus.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Dig Site pendant is a fast way offering 3 locations around the Dig Site:
• The Dig Site option places the player in front of the Archaeology Guild.
• The Senntisten option in the north-east of the Dig Site near the winch.
• The Exam Centre option south of the Dig Site inside the Exam Centre.
• The Archaeology journal will teleport the player in front of the Archaeology Guild.
• Players can use the earth altar teleport to teleport to the earth altar and run south-east.
• Open the invitation box to teleport to the Empyrean Citadel, then open the Invitation Box while in the Empyrean Citadel to teleport to Brother Samwell, then run southwest to the Varrock Dig Site.
• Players can use the Empty Throne Room teleport on the master quest cape or the Senntisten Teleport spell in the Ancient Magicks spellbook to arrive to the east of the Dig Site, exit the Empty Throne Room and run west.
• Players can use the elder divination outfit to teleport to the nearby bright wisp colony and run east.
• Players without access to the methods above can purchase a Fort Forinthry Teleport scroll from the Grand Exchange and run south-east or use the Varrock lodestone and run east.

28682.d: The Varrock Sewers resource dungeon is one of the 14 resource dungeons released on 19 July 2010.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Enter the Varrock Sewers and follow them down to the spiderweb. Push through the web and follow the corridor to the moss giants. Alternatively, players with 51 Agility can also use the Edgeville Dungeon pipe shortcut and proceed to the southern moss giants.

Players with at least 99 Dungeoneering may use the Dungeoneering cape's perk. The perk allows players to teleport to the entrance of any available resource dungeon an infinite number of times by choosing "Varrock moss giant dungeon" via the "activate" option on the cape.

28709.d: The Vault of Hereditas is a heist area requiring level 95 Thieving to access.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The Vault of Hereditas entrance can be found in the south-east area of the main fortress within the Kharid-et Dig Site, which requires the completion of the Breaking the Seal mystery to access. Players will need to talk to Liara first, who is standing just outside the vault entrance. Level 95 Thieving is required to enter. The requirement is not boostable.

To get to the dig site:
• Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop, or master archaeologist's hat teleport when wearing full master archaeologist's outfit.
• Archaeology journal: teleport to the Archaeology Campus then run west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to Kharid-et directly.
• Al Kharid lodestone and run east.
